claim_context: The units are the approximate change in dollar delta exposure for that move, not option premium, market capitalization or a directly observed future order. An option bought long has positive gamma whether it is a call or a put. The sign of a dealer's exposure depends on the dealer's position, not the option type. [OIC: Gamma](https://www.optionseducation.org/advancedconcepts/gamma), undated, accessed September 2026.

claim_context: This is aggregate intrinsic payout at expiration under the included OI, not traders' total realized pain: it excludes premiums paid, hedges, closing trades and later OI changes. claim_context: A disclaimer alone does not determine whether a paid service is investment advice. Personalized recommendations based on a subscriber's portfolio, risk budget or needs deserve a focused US securities-law review before public release. The SEC's publisher-exclusion guidance is fact-specific, including impersonality, bona fide analysis and general/regular circulation; a website or “educational” label does not settle it. [SEC: Jonathon Hendricks staff response](https://www.sec.gov/divisions/investment/noaction/2015/jonathon-hendricks-012615-202a.htm), January 26, 2015. Automated advice can still be advisory activity.
